description: Header file defining the ChannelSelectionTask class for managing Wi-Fi channel selection, including handling vendor-specific messages, ZWDFS flow, and channel preferences within the beerocks namespace.

classes.name: ChannelSelectionTask
classes.description: Manages Wi-Fi channel selection, handles vendor-specific messages, ZWDFS flow, and channel preferences within the beerocks namespace.

methods.name: work
methods.description: Performs the main task processing logic.

methods.name: handle_event
methods.description: Handles events such as AP_DISABLED and AP_ENABLED.

methods.name: handle_cmdu
methods.description: Processes incoming CMDU messages.

methods.name: handle_channel_preference_query
methods.description: Handles channel preference query messages.

methods.name: handle_channel_selection_request
methods.description: Handles channel selection request messages.

methods.name: handle_vendor_specific
methods.description: Handles vendor-specific CMDU messages.

methods.description: Handles CAC started notification vendor-specific messages.

methods.name: handle_vs_dfs_cac_completed_notification
methods.description: Handles DFS CAC completed notification vendor-specific messages.

methods.name: handle_vs_channels_list_response
methods.description: Handles channels list response vendor-specific messages.

methods.name: handle_vs_zwdfs_ant_channel_switch_response
methods.description: Handles ZWDFS antenna channel switch response vendor-specific messages.

methods.name: handle_ap_disabled_event
methods.description: Handles AP disabled events.

methods.name: handle_ap_enable_event
